fields.why: Prevalence and incidence are tabulated by five race/ethnicity groups and five age groups, and the text ranks them ('lower among whites than among other racial/ethnic groups').
Race/ethnicity and age have 5 levels each; sex is binary and sex-within-race contrasts are pairwise per margin.
No CIs or tests are reported for group contrasts (margin of error <0.02%); joinpoint is fitted to the overall series only.
